clips.title: The story
paras: Mr. Smite is the imposing tauren first mate serving aboard the Defias Brotherhood's flagship deep inside the Deadmines. An expert weaponmaster under Captain Greenskin, he commands the dockside approach to the hidden juggernaut with ruthless discipline. Intruders who face him must contend with his shifting arsenal and devastating physical strength.

Guarding the docks of Ironclad Cove, Mr. Smite serves as first mate to the goblin Captain Greenskin. While the Defias Brotherhood is predominantly composed of disenfranchised humans and allied goblin tinkerers, Smite stands as a striking anomaly: a massive, battle-hardened tauren far from the plains of Kalimdor. Tasked with maintaining strict order among a rowdy pirate crew, he ensures that the labor fitting out Edwin VanCleef's secret dreadnaught proceeds without disruption.
